notablePrerequisites: You have a way to create a token.
description:
Cast Artificial Evolution by paying {U}, changing all instances of "Phyrexian" on Essence of Orthodoxy to "Cat" or "Dog" until end of turn.
Create a token, choosing instead to create a 2/2 Cat creature token with haste or a 3/1 Dog creature token with vigilance.
When the Cat or Dog enters the battlefield, Essence of Orthodoxy triggers, creating a 2/2 Cat creature token with haste or a 3/1 Dog creature token with vigilance.
Repeat step 3.
